fact: The terms of reference (PAENS, July 2026) state that the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital (MTN) has validated its Lettre de Politique Sectorielle (LPS), tied to the 2025-2029 National Development Strategy; no adoption is stated and the document gives no date for the validation, so the July 2026 imprint date is used.
APS reports that the ministry's secretary general chaired the final validation workshop for the Lettre de Politique Sectorielle 2025-2029 with the ecosystem's actors; no adoption is reported.
APS gives the Lettre de Politique Sectorielle's period as 2025-2029; the date is the article's published date, the workshop being held on a Monday.
